children: On September 3, 2026, the company received a Nasdaq notice that it failed to meet the $2.5 million stockholders' equity requirement, giving it 45 days to submit a compliance plan and potentially up to 180 days to regain compliance if accepted. This follows a July 17, 2026 notice that it failed the $1.00 minimum bid price rule, with a 180-day period until January 13, 2027 to cure and a potential second 180-day period if other standards are met.
